description: Deterministic JSON hashing + structured extraction for AI agents. RFC 8785 canonicalization, SHA-256/512, EIP-712 signed attestations, Needle 3 extraction. x402-native.

resources.description: RFC 8785 JSON canonicalization + SHA-256/512 hash + EIP-712 signed attestation. Deterministic: same input produces the same output, byte-for-byte, in any runtime. Use when an agent needs an idempotency key, cache key, dedup hash, or verifiable commitment for a JSON payload.
Batch RFC 8785 JSON canonicalization + SHA-256/512 hash for up to 1000 payloads, one attestation, one payment. Use when an agent needs to hash a structured dataset in a single round-trip.

Extract structured JSON from messy text. Deterministic Tier 1 (regex, exact) first; Needle 3 model fallback for free-form text. Use when an agent needs to turn emails, logs, tickets, or notes into fields it can act on. No charge on extraction failure.
